scripts.wxpr:build: pnpm --filter @wxpr/tokens build && pnpm --filter @wxpr/icons build && pnpm --filter @wxpr/react build
scripts.dev: pnpm run wxpr:build && pnpm --filter @albaconnect/shared build && turbo run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run wxpr:build && turbo run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run wxpr:build && pnpm --filter @albaconnect/shared build && pnpm --filter @albaconnect/api test && pnpm --filter @albaconnect/web test
